description: This file defines the API for a text-based commit graph visualization component used in a version control system like Git. It includes function declarations for initializing, updating, rendering, and managing a graphical representation of commit history, along with detailed comments and usage examples.

methods.name: graph_setup_line_prefix
methods.description: Configures global line prefix display options based on diff options.

methods.name: graph_set_column_colors
methods.description: Sets a custom color scheme for graph columns, allowing for HTML or other color escapes.

methods.name: graph_init
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new git_graph structure based on revision info.

methods.name: graph_clear
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a git_graph structure.

methods.name: graph_update
methods.description: Updates the graph with a new commit, affecting subsequent line rendering.

methods.name: graph_is_commit_finished
methods.description: Checks if all lines for the current commit have been output, indicating readiness for the next update.

methods.name: graph_next_line
methods.description: Outputs the next line of the graph into a string buffer; distinguishes between commit lines and padding lines.

methods.name: graph_width
methods.description: Returns the current width of the graph in characters.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Prints the entire commit's graph lines to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Prints a single line of the graph to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Prints vertical padding lines for the graph.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Prints remaining graph lines for the current commit.

methods.name: graph_show_commit_msg
methods.description: Displays the commit message and the remaining graph lines to a specified file handle.
